How we get started

Keep it simple.

Work directly with the person doing the work. You don’t need the technical terms—just an idea of what you want to do or what isn’t working.

  1. 01

    Start a conversation.

    Tell me about your project or the problem you’re having. A link, photo, or device model is a useful starting point.

  2. 02

    Know the plan.

    Talk through what’s involved, what it will cost, and a practical timeline before the work starts.

  3. 03

    Put it to work.

    Walk through the finished work and get answers to your questions about using it.

A few useful answers

Before you reach out.

What will it cost?

The cost depends on the project or device and the work involved. Send a few details so we can discuss the scope and a quote.

Can you repair my phone or computer?

Repair options depend on the model, the issue, and the parts needed. Include the device model and a description of what’s happening. We’ll work out the options from there.

Where are you based?

Fremont Digital is based in Fremont County, Wyoming. Contact me first to discuss your project and arrange any device handoff. A public storefront is not available at this time.

What if my project isn’t listed?

Ask. If it involves technology, a website, photography, or video, it’s worth a conversation. I’ll be clear about whether it’s something I can take on.
